commands.command: it seems like i've been wandering around without purpose since eating all the food. i should re-check the rooms to see if any new items have appeared, but since none have, and my health is slowly decreasing, i'm stuck. i'll end the mental loop here.
the game ends here; you've looped through all areas and eaten what you could. with no new actions to take, you simply wait.
